digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler package restructure and guarded-pass consolidation
propositions: The Jira reconciler package at src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/ must be relocated to rebar.reconciler as an ordinary subpackage with all by-path loaders (lazy_load, spec_from_file_location, sys.path.insert) removed from src/ and tests/
The guarded-core bug where library _lib_ops._bridge_run bypasses the core lock must be fixed so CLI, library, and MCP bridge_sync all run through run_guarded_pass taking the reconciler lease

The three-hop bridge chain (_bridge_runner → rebar bridge sync → python -m rebar_reconciler) must collapse to direct spawn of python -m rebar.reconciler with start_new_session=True and process-group reap via rebar._proc.reap_process_group on timeout

Three retired toggles (REBAR_RECONCILER_CREATE_ROUTE, REBAR_RECONCILER_WRITE_FACADE, REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP), five dormant modules, dead half of outbound_fields.py, two dead MutationAction pairs, and _call_with_retry must be deleted with their tests
Bridge scratch must move from bridge_state/ at repo root to .rebar/bridge/ with keep-last-5 retention on snapshots and sync logs, 30-day alert window, pruned on every persisted pass

Ratchet baseline keys in .github/complexity-baseline.json (6 keys) and .github/mechanism-baseline.json (29 keys) must be re-spelled with value-preserving prefix rewrites to track rebar.reconciler paths after package move
